title: UNRWA Chief Warns of ‘De-Facto’ Annexation of the West Bank
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
After two consecutive terms as the head of the United Nations Relief and Works
Agency, better known as [UNRWA](https://zeteo.com/p/debunked-seven-israeli-
myths-about?utm_source=publication-search), **Philippe Lazzarini 's** tenure
at the agency is coming to an end. The outgoing Commissioner-General joins
**Mehdi** to reflect on the organization he leaves behind, the current reality
in Palestine as it's overshadowed by the war in
[Iran](https://zeteo.com/p/i-wargamed-iran-for-obama-this-is), and the ways in
which [Israel](https://zeteo.com/p/cbs-owner-paramount-pushed-pro-israel) has
attacked UNRWA and how it can survive.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

From [settler violence](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-in-palestine-israeli-
settlers) in the occupied West Bank to what Lazzarini describes as a **"
cease-fire by name" **in occupied Gaza, the UNRWA official remarks on the
headlines not making the front page because of the war on Iran. **" Life there
is still extraordinarily miserable," **he tells Mehdi.

This important and wide-ranging discussion includes:

  * How US Ambassador to Israel [Mike Huckabee](https://zeteo.com/p/11-lies-mike-huckabee-israel-carlson-debunk?utm_source=publication-search) is **" endorsing" **the vision for a 'greater Israel.'

  * The **" de facto annexation" **of the occupied West Bank.

  * How Trump's '[Board of Peace](https://zeteo.com/p/tony-blair-should-be-on-trial-for?utm_source=publication-search)' is a **" bad copy of what the United Nations has been all about."**

  * Funding, and what Lazzarini's successor must do to guarantee the organization's survival.

  * What a reformed UN looks like and the path to making it more effective.
